title: What we learned running Community Day 2025
description: Notes from the organizers on venues, sponsors, speakers and the small decisions that mattered. Sample post.
author: sample-organizer-one
body:
Running a 300-person community conference with volunteers teaches you quickly where the real work is.

## Start with the venue

Book early, walk the space and confirm power, Wi-Fi and food before anything else.

## Keep the programme honest

A smaller number of well-prepared talks beats a packed schedule.

## Thank the people

Speakers, sponsors and volunteers make the day. Say so, publicly and often.
